dataset.name: Lung adenocarcinoma (CDDP EAGLE)
dataset.description: Population-based lung adenocarcinoma cohort with open GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq STAR-counts and linked overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: Primary lung adenocarcinomas from the Environment And Genetics in Lung cancer Etiology study in Lombardy, Italy. This epidemiologic cohort remains separate from TCGA-LUAD and other external LUAD releases.
dataset.publication_citation: Landi et al. BMC Public Health 2008

metadata.redistribution_note: The open cohort is analyzable in TRACE Explorer, but matrix downloads remain disabled pending a dedicated redistribution review.
metadata.curation_note: The GDC project is explicitly restricted to lung adenocarcinoma. One primary-tumor STAR-counts file is selected per endpoint-complete participant before matrix construction.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
